responsibility: Implements RTL CFG simplification and cleanup, centered on `cleanup_cfg` and the backend jump passes that invoke it. It removes unreachable blocks, forwards edges through trivial forwarders, merges tails via cross-jumping, simplifies conditional-jump-around-jump patterns, merges adjacent blocks, optionally runs dead-code cleanup, and repairs loop structure when CFG changes invalidate it. This file is the main post-transformation tidier for RTL control flow, consuming a possibly messy CFG and producing a simpler, more canonical one for later backend passes.
same_name_distinction: Implements the RTL CFG cleanup engine and jump passes, performing transformations such as unreachable-block deletion, edge forwarding, cross-jumping, conditional-jump simplification, block merging, and related loop repair; unlike gcc/cfgcleanup.h, which only declares cleanup_cfg and related public cleanup APIs.
